title: Mathematics in the age of AI
summary: This academic paper explores how artificial intelligence is transforming mathematical research, including AI-assisted theorem proving, mathematical discovery, and the future relationship between computational methods and pure mathematics.
problem_solved: Explores how AI can assist, accelerate, and potentially transform mathematical research and proof discovery.
why_valuable: Provides insights into the evolving symbiosis between AI and mathematics, offering perspectives on how computational tools are reshaping one of humanity's oldest intellectual pursuits.
